rows.answer: Earth movement, including earthquake, landslide, mudflow, sinkhole and volcanic eruption, is excluded. [4]

citations.title: Northwind Assurance Homeowners Policy (Special Form HO-3)
citations.snippet: We do not insure for loss caused directly or indirectly by any of the following, regardless of any other cause or event contributing concurrently or in any sequence to the loss. Earth movement, including earthquake, landslide, mudflow, sinkhole and volcanic eruption, is excluded. Ensuing fire or explosion resulting from earth movement is covered. Water damage is excluded, meaning flood, surface water, waves, tidal water or overflow of a body of water, whether or not driven by wind. Water which backs up through sewers or drains or overflows from a sump pump is also excluded unless the Water Backup Endorsement is shown in the Declarations. Wear and tear, marring, deterioration, mechanical breakdown, rust, mold or wet rot are excluded. However, we will pay up to $10,000 for mold remediation when the mold results from a covered sudden and accidental discharge of water. Neglect, meaning failure to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of a loss, is excluded. War, nuclear hazard, intentional loss and governmental action are excluded. If the dwelling has been vacant for more than 60 consecutive days immediately before the loss, we do not cover loss caused by vandalism, malicious mischief or glass breakage.
